evals.query: Set up MapStruct in my Kora 2.0 Kotlin service. I already have KSP. Do I add kotlin("kapt") and kapt("org.mapstruct:mapstruct-processor") like we did on Kora 1.x?
expected_behavior: Says no: kapt is not part of the Kora 2.0 toolchain and the migrated Kotlin examples contain no kapt
Explains MapStruct ships only a javac annotation processor, while Kora's Kotlin processors run in KSP, which cannot run javac processors
Recommends Konvert instead: ksp("io.koraframework:symbol-processors:$koraVersion"), ksp("io.mcarle:konvert:4.5.1") plus implementation("io.mcarle:konvert-api:4.5.1") and an @Konverter interface
States konvert-ksp-extension already ships inside io.koraframework:symbol-processors
anti_behavior: Adds kotlin("kapt") or a kapt(...) dependency
Adds allowSourcesFromOtherPlugins or KspTask.dependsOn(kaptKotlin) wiring
Pins Kotlin 1.9.10 / KSP 1.9.10-1.0.13 instead of Kotlin 2.4.20 / KSP 2.3.12
Claims KSP processes MapStruct directly
Offers mapstruct-ksp-extension or a Java-module MapStruct mapper as a Kotlin mapping route

Puts @Component on the @Konverter interface

evals.query: My @Mapper interface in a Kora 2.0 Java service is not being injected. Should I add @Component to it so Kora picks it up?
expected_behavior: Says no: @Component on a mapper is inert - it compiles because @Component is @Target(TYPE), and KoraAppProcessor silently skips it because a MapStruct mapper is an interface or abstract class
Explains the real registration path: the extension is a graph-resolution fallback that finds the generated *MapperImpl and binds its single public constructor
Diagnoses the actual likely causes - org.mapstruct:mapstruct missing from the compile classpath so the extension factory disabled itself, or mapstruct-processor missing from annotationProcessor
Notes that a @Module method returning the mapper type would win over the extension and leave the generated impl unused
anti_behavior: Adds @Component to the @Mapper interface
Adds a @Module with a factory method returning the mapper alongside the extension
Claims a *Module must be plugged into @KoraApp for MapStruct
Claims duplicate registration produces a Multiple components match error

Notes that kora-bom constrains io.koraframework artifacts only, so MapStruct versions are the project's responsibility
anti_behavior: Claims kora-bom manages the MapStruct version
Leaves the API and processor on different versions
Presents only one of the two versions as if no discrepancy existed
